title: Each type at a shaadi
caption:
Shaadi season is here, and every type has a role whether they signed up or not.

From the cousin who arrives two hours 'late' on purpose to the one holding the sound system together with a hairclip, every khandan has all 16. Swipe through and find yourself, your siblings and that one chacha who runs the photo queue.

Tag your shaadi squad and assign everyone a slide.

Which one are you at the next function?
